title: Congruence to zero characterizes divisibility
statement: For all natural numbers m and n, n is congruent to 0 modulo m if and only if m divides n.

formal.statement: theorem Nat.mod_eq_zero_iff_dvd : ((x0 : AxNat) -> ((x1 : AxNat) -> Iff (AxNat.modEq x0 x1 AxNat.zero) (AxNat.dvd x0 x1)))
